description: This file defines the NumericField class for rendering numeric fields in Drupal views, including options for formatting, precision, pluralization, and display customization.

classes.name: NumericField
classes.description: A class that renders a numeric value in Drupal views, with configurable formatting options.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for numeric formatting, including precision, separator, and pluralization.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for configuring the numeric field options in Drupal views.

methods.name: submitOptionsForm
methods.description: Handles submission of the options form, merging pluralization strings.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the numeric value with formatting, rounding, and pluralization based on options.
